#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

# Load environment variables from .env.test
if [[ ! -f .env.test ]]; then
  echo "Error: .env.test file not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Source all key=value pairs from .env.test, ignoring comments and blank lines
while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
  [[ -z "$key" || "$key" == \#* ]] && continue
  export "$key=$value"
done < .env.test

# Set ADMIN_TOKEN from the API_KEY entry in .env.test
export ADMIN_TOKEN="$(cat .env.test | grep API_KEY | cut -d= -f2)"

echo "Environment configured from .env.test"
echo "ADMIN_TOKEN is set."
